title: Password change reminder

left.subject: Change your password now
left.bodyHtml:
Dear Jonah,

If you don’t change your password, it will expire in 14 days and you may lose access to key apps.

How do I change my password?

Go to the HR portal from the intranet.

right.subject: Change your password now
right.bodyHtml:
Dear Jonah,

If you don’t change your password, it will expire in 14 days and you may lose access to key apps.

How do I change my password?

Change your password now by clicking here and entering your credentials.

explainPoints: Look-alike domain: nexatrvst.com swaps the letter “u” for “v”. Attackers use tiny changes like this to trick people into trusting the sender.
Wrong mailbox: it was sent to a personal address (gmail), not your @nexatrust.com work address. Password and account notices should stay within company email.
Unsafe path: it asks you to “click here” and enter credentials. Real NexaTrust guidance tells you to open the known HR/IT portal from the intranet or bookmarks—no login links in email.
Trust cues: the subject and wording are generic and urgent. Real notices include clear next steps and refer to official portals instead of vague links.
